jobs_results.title: Senior UI Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Gran vacante Senior Engineer en proceso de contratación Gran vacante Senior Engineer en proceso de contratación sage careers Portal del solicit ante

Información sobre el trabajo:
Senior Engineer

Información completa del trabajo.
Nombre de vacante Senior Engineer Descripción We are seeking a highly skilled Senior UI Engineer (ideally full stack or with backend knowledge) to join our Service Fabric team in Barcelona.

Service Fabric is a technology platform that enables Sage to deliver common capabilities required across multiple Sage cloud or cloud-connected products.

As a Senior Engineer, you are going to collaborate in the design, develop and delivery of high-quality products and services that exceed customers’ or business partners’ expectations.

You will be part of a team inside Sage’s global Service Fabric organisation, located in multiple countries around the globe. You’ll be part of a dynamic team focused on integration and enablement activities. Responsabilidades principal... es Your responsibilities will be to:

• Design and develop user interfaces for web applications (mobile friendly), using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and related front-end frameworks such as React and/or Angular

• Collaborate with designers, product managers, and back-end developers to ensure a seamless user experience

• Translate UI/UX design wireframes into high-quality code

• Develop reusable UI components and libraries

• Optimize user interfaces for performance and responsiveness

• Mentor and lead other engineers in the team

• Participate in code reviews to maintain high code quality standards

• Improve code quality by implementing best practices and design patterns

• Communicate with other teams to understand requirements and propose solutions

We would love to meet you if you:

• Have developed using a variety of technologies, with experience in front-end frameworks - React and/or Angular.

• Hands-on experience in .NET backend development. Knowledge of Node.

JS

• Keen interest in learning new programming languages and tools.

• You enjoy reading code and fully understanding the environment in which it runs, from the network stack to the back-end storage layers and everything in between.

• Experience with AWS or an alternative cloud environment

• Experience working with Agile methodologies and CI/CD processes

• Familiarity with development and deployment of cloud-based products

Independently of your technical profile and background, we put value on collaboration and communication skills, displaying an agile mindset and having reasonable amounts of autonomy and accountability.

Why you would love to join us?

Impact:
You’ll be working alongside a tremendous team of highly skilled engineers on products that make a real impact on our customers.

Culture:

You will be working in a multicultural and diverse environment.

Environment:
Fantastic tech environment, using the best of breed and cutting-edge technologies.

Community:
Make a difference to communities we live and work in, with your 5 volunteer days every year. How we are making a difference

Continuous Development:
Unlimited access to Pluralsight, Linkedin Learning and Sage University.

Career Growth:
Long-term prospects for a professional career. Access to Talent Marketplace, an internal system that uses artificial intelligence to create a clear path for growth.

The flexible Human Work approach will provide you an opportunity to unlock all forms of flexibility (mode, location, and time).

Brand office space, locates at the heart of Barcelona’s 22@tech district, with great transport links.

Reduced working hours in the summer.

Flexible benefits that suit your needs.

Ready to take up this challenge? Apply today or contact us for more information.

At Sage, we recognize that the world of work has rapidly shifted over the last few years, particularly how we work. That is why we have committed to working in a hybrid way going forward. jobs_results.title: Ingeniero Electrónico Senior
jobs_results.description:
Buscamos un experto en electrónica, ingeniero senior con más de 10 años de experiencia, que tenga altas capacidades en diseño y desarrollo electrónico. Trabajará con el resto de ingenieros de nuestro equipo en diferentes desarrollos de nuestra tecnología RSD.

TU MISIÓN:
• Trabajar con el equipo de ingeniería de Opus RSE en Madrid en diferentes desarrollos tecnológicos.
• Liderar diferentes desarrollos electrónicos, con alta autonomía y un excelente trabajo en equipo.
• Aportar tus capacidades para mejorar una tecnología única en el mundo, pero que está en continua mejora.

REQUISITOS MÍNIMOS:
• Idiomas: nivel total de fluidez en español y muy buen nivel en inglés.
• Educación: universitaria en ingeniería electrónica.
• Experiencia en desarrollo de Firmware (microchip PIC32) y DSP.
• Experiencia en desarrollos electrónicos de altas prestaciones y de arquitecturas complejas, incluyendo FPGA.
• Experiencia en reparación de tarjetas electrónicas (soldadura, testeo, etc.).
• Experiencia... en puesta a punto de equipos y pruebas (generación de reportes e informes).
• Experiencia en diseño HW a nivel esquemático con herramientas como LTSpice o similar.
• Experiencia en diseño de PCBs y circuitos.
• Conocimientos generales de firmware y programación en C.
• Alta capacidad de trabajo proactivo, llevando desarrollos tanto en solitario como con el resto de ingenieros.

REQUISITOS ADICIONALES DESEABLES:
• Experiencia demostrada en la coordinación técnica de equipos de ingeniería.
• Experiencia demostrada en ejecutar proyectos de desarrollo a alta velocidad y bajo elevados estándares de calidad.
• Experiencia en programación de microcontroladores Microchip.
• Experiencia en programación de aplicaciones de escritorio para testing de hardware.
• Experiencia en la búsqueda y gestión de proveedores.
• Experiencia en el desarrollo de nuevos productos.
• Experiencia en generación de documentación técnica (manuales, fichas técnicas, informes técnicos, etc.).

LO QUE OFRECEMOS:
• Incorporación inmediata.
• Empresa sólida y en rápida expansión. Una empresa y un producto únicos en todo el mundo. Somos una pequeña empresa "boutique" española, integrada en una gran empresa internacional de 2,600 empleados, con oficinas en 34 países.
• Un ambiente de trabajo espectacular, con compañeros de muy alto nivel en sus diferentes especialidades y gran valor humano. Aprenderás de los mejores.
• Un reto desafiante. Un lugar con un ritmo cambiante y proyectos innovadores, que impulsará tu carrera y tus capacidades.
• Salario competitivo de acuerdo con la experiencia y la habilidad

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer, Ingeniero de Software, HTML CSS
jobs_results.description:
When you are enjoying content on TV, radio, smartphone, tablet or PC, you are also watching the works of the team that helps put that content right there. The mission of MEDIAGENIX is to enable renowned media companies (e.g. BBC, Disney, Discovery, Paramount) worldwide to bring content to the viewer in the most efficient and future-proof way with the help of our broadcast management system
.

To support media companies in their growth in this fast-paced media world, we deliver innovative software solutions on premise or web-based in the cloud that optimize the life cycle of their content across channels and services.

Be key to this stimulating new journey and help change the game of media operations with state-of-the-art technologies as the new Backend Software Engineer at BeBanjo!

Be Banjo , part of MEDIAGENIX, is the reference non-linear scheduling system. It is well known for developing a software solution that allows some of the world's most successful media companies such as... BBC Studios, ITV and Warner Media to create schedules and plans to manage workflows, rights and metadata simply and efficiently.
Your challenge
• At BeBanjo, developers work in two independent teams:
Project and Product. The Project team takes care of building custom integrations for our clients, while the Product team is responsible for maintaining and implementing new features for our core Products. We are currently hiring for the Projects team
.

These are some of challenges that you, together with the Projects team, work on:
• You're using our own Ruby framework and build an integration to sync our client's data with third parties.
• You're helping new customers on-boarding process by working on data migration plans
, and workflow automations
.
• You're working with the Technical Account Managers on designing solutions for the specific customer demands. You decide on the technical details and estimate the expected effort.
• You keep our components ecosystem at peak performance (i.e. stack up to date, review past design decisions, benchmark and profile, etc).

As a Projects team developer you should expect working with Ruby
,
MySQL
, and several AWS services
: SNS, SQS, AWS Lambda, and Dynamo

DB.
Our wish list
• You have significant experience building digital products of any kind.
• You understand the importance of having a solid test suite
.
• You have some experience with our stack:
Ruby on Rails, Elasticsearch, MySQL,
Vue.js, Hot Wire…
• We use AWS extensively. Any prior experience is considered a plus.
• You live in Spain
.

Next to this, we're looking for someone empathetic and curious, with clear communication skills and a willingness to listen. If you're deeply committed to your work and team success, self-motivated to work independently
, and adept at staying organized and focused, you'll thrive in our international team of talented, considerate individuals!

Don’t rule yourself out if you think you don’t tick all the boxes
. We’re looking for keen learners with a great attitude.
Our offer
• Work from anywhere in Spain with flexible schedules so that you can be there for the people you love, avoid commuting every day, be a nomad, find the environment where you’re most productive, and plan your day exactly how you like it.
• Depending on your experience, the salary range for this position is €45 000 - €55 000 annually.
• An indefinite contract. We value long-term relationships with our staff.
• Great flexibility to enjoy however you prefer your 23 days of annual holidays (in addition to the regular bank holidays).
• Support for your continuing education and professional growth
: books, workshops, conferences…
• An inclusive, supportive, and stable environment where your best work can happen.

Excited? So are we! Take the next step by
applying
below and let us demonstrate the endless possibilities at MEDIAGENIX.

We're already looking forward to meeting you!
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Ascertia is a global leader in PKI and high-trust electronic signature solutions. The company designs and develops software products in-house and sells these to a global audience, mainly through a network of local reseller partners. Ascertia has experienced solid revenue growth and is hiring a number of new team members to drive more sales and take on larger big-name organisations in the industry. Ascertia has over 100 full-time employees and is looking for a new Senior Software Developer. This opportunity provides a great platform for the successful candidate to stretch themselves and work with a great team to achieve global success. We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Software Developer to join our dynamic team, working remotely with a preference for candidates based in and around Madrid, Spain. Our ideal candidate will be passionate about creating seamless integration solutions for our core products and have a strong background in front-end and middle layer... development.

Responsibilities:

As a Senior Software Developer at Ascertia, you will:
• Design and develop integrations for our core products using JavaScript, C# and .NET Core, with some knowledge of Java. Skills in other languages may be required depending on the integration.
• Create and optimize front-end systems, ensuring an exceptional user experience.
• Create and optimize middle layer integrations between our core products and 3rd party software.
• Identify and implement improved integration methods for increased efficiency and user satisfaction.
• Ensure security and privacy by design methods are followed during the implementation of these integrations.
• Deploy and configure the solutions using technologies such as Docker.
• Maintain cross-browser compatibility for all integrations, ensuring a consistent experience across platforms.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive integration projects, both internally and with third-party systems.
• Provide technical support and guidance on integration-related issues.

Qualifications:
• 5+ years of experience in software development, with a focus on integrations.
• Backend development experience in C# (.NET Core), and Java, as well as experience with microservices.
• Understanding of technologies such as JavaScript, including Node and Typescript.
• Knowledge of REST APIs and related frameworks, along with testing with Postman.
• Experience with the Atlassian stack, including Jira, Bitbucket, and Confluence.
• Experience working in Agile methodologies and in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience integrating with systems such as Salesforce, SharePoint, MS Teams, and other Microsoft products.
• Familiarity with additional systems like Oracle E-Business Suite and SAP is a plus.
• Understanding of security by design principles.

What We Offer:
• Competitive salary
• Opportunities for professional growth and development.
• Collaborative and supportive work environment.
• The chance to make a tangible impact on the company's success.
• Remote work with preference for candidates based in and around Madrid, Spain.

If you are a motivated and skilled Senior Software Developer looking for an exciting remote opportunity to showcase your talent and contribute to the success of Ascertia, please apply with your updated resume and a brief cover letter highlighting your relevant experience.

Why work for Ascertia?

Ascertia is a UK private limited company, owned by its directors and key employees. The focus of the company is the development of high trust PKI products and electronic signature solutions and the sale of these directly and through our partner network that spans the world. Ascertia is recognised brand with a good number of industry leaders recommend or resell Ascertia products. Gartner rates Ascertia very well for our leadership position in providing EU eIDAS compliant signing solutions and our proven global delivery capability. We are a friendly team of people that focus on getting the right relationships with our key partners, customers and colleagues. Revenues have grown very well in the last four years and there is excellent potential for continued growth.

www.ascertia.com

We look forward to hearing from you and discussing how you can become an integral part of our team

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Since its foundation in 1925, the DEKRA promise has been to ensure the safety of human interaction with technology and the environment. The company currently employs around 52,000 people in more than 60 countries on all five continents. With qualified and independent expert services, they provide safety on the road, at work and at home.

We have a clear and ambitious vision of the future. The vision for our 100th birthday in 2025 is to see DEKRA as the global partner for a safe world.

An exciting opportunity has arisen in our DIGITAL & PRODUCT SOLUTIONS Division. This area is to focus on tech competencies and drive digital innovation to help leading DEKRA into a successful future.

You want to know more? Here we go!

Role position:

We are currently looking for a Senior Software Engineer to strengthen our Inteligence Artificial Team.

About AI & Advanced Analytics Team:

Our vision in DEKRA is to make Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Advanced Analytics (AA) an essential driver of... value creation by 2025. Therefore, we founded the “DEKRA AI Hub” as central institution for the application of AI-based technologies within the DEKRA Group.

We develop AI and Machine Learning (ML) solutions to improve our processes and service portfolio as well as to leverage new business potentials in a wide range of verticals and uses cases. We also work on the development of tools for AI solution testing as key to ensure safety of high-risk products, such as the Autonomous Car or bio-medical applications.

We are looking for a highly proactive data passionate to join our global AI & Advanced Analytics team.

Responsibilities:
• Design and implement microservice architectures for new and existing software programs with focus on AI and Advanced Analytics.
• Provide access to structured and non-structured data coming from different sources.
• Put Software Products into production both in cloud and on-premise environments and deliver to end customers.
• Configure and maintain servers.
• Team up with Data Platform team to include new Cloud AI components into the development stack, including generative AI tools and large language models.
• Conduct code reviews and ensure the quality of the developed solutions.

jobs_results.title: Senior FullStack Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We’re on the search for a highly experienced Senior Fullstack Software Engineer, ready to join our Development team in building and supporting our Plytix PIM. Our Development team is based in Malaga, but if you code best from the comfort of your own home or even from a different city, no problem—the location doesn’t matter, you do!

What is Plytix?

This is where you’d typically see a long paragraph of boring text that no one reads, peppered with corporate buzzwords that don’t mean anything. But Plytix is no typical company, so we’ll spare you from that. Instead, watch this video, and if you like what you see, keep scrolling.

👉 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nGQDV5fNGp4

What’s the opportunity?

This is your chance to play a part in building a leading multichannel platform, working with diverse talent and innovative technology. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of an ever-expanding scale-up with your ideas and coding experience.

What will you be doing?

A day... in the life of a Plytix developer is an exciting one. You’ll be collaborating on challenges, like taking an active role in the service designs and making sure that they are scalable and robust. You will need to ensure these designs are implemented following the latest design patterns and best practices. You’ll have scrum ceremonies to stay on the same page as your fellow developers, from retrospective meetings to sprint planning. You’ll always be aligned with your team for when you dive into pull requests or user stories. All in all, you’ll be a busy bee. But don’t worry, there’s always time to crack open a beer and have fun!

After 1 month:

You’ll have a good grasp of our favorite tools and processes, and your code will start flowing. You’ll start reviewing user stories and will be given small tasks so that you can start to show off your engineering skills. You’ll take part in peer reviews with QA, making sure that clients don’t spot any errors before we do.

After 3 months:

You’re now becoming a true Plytix dev, evaluating and estimating user stories. You’re writing tests and working more independently. You still have some supervision, but at this point, you’re feeling comfortable with what you are doing. You’re taking part in sprints and beginning to integrate well into the team’s workflow.

6 months in:

You’re fully integrated into the team. You work just as well (and as quickly) as anyone else on the team! You’re collaborating with other departments to find the best possible solutions for our customers to have the best quality system. You’re delivering high-quality, fast-running code that’ll be tested to iron out any potential errors. By now, you’re confident in your role, reviewing and approving other engineers’ code (always following our standards, of course!) and even providing advice to junior developers.

Who will you be working with?

You’ll be working with your fellow frontend and backend engineers, making sure that everything is running smoothly, but they aren’t the only shining faces you’ll be working with on a daily basis. You’ll also be working with the QA and Product teams to keep customers smiling about how amazing their Plytix PIM is.

If you’re curious about what our dev culture is like, take a peek at what Plytix’s development team has to offer —you know you want to.

We expect you to:
• At least 8 years of work experience in web software development
• Have 5+ years of experience in Frontend technologies
• Proven experience in Angular2+ Frontend Development (3+ years)
• Proven experience in Python Backend Web Development (3+ years)
• Strong Python 3+ foundations (Parallelism/Concurrency/generators/decorators/etc.)
• High level of knowledge of RxJs and how it works under the hood
• Strong vanilla JavaScript foundations
• Experience working in an environment based on Docker, Kubernetes and Linux as O.S.

You might also have:
• Experience in message brokers like RabbitMQ
• Understanding of cloud-native distributed systems and microservices

Nice to have:
• Experience with Web ComponentsExperience working with CI/CD tools
• Knowledge of Micro Frontends with Angular (SingleSPA or similar)

Why work at Plytix?

🏆 Voted Malaga’s #1 employer by Great Place to Work®

❤️ Be a part of a welcoming culture with bright, friendly people from around the world

🌱 Have a purpose and plenty of opportunities to grow from day one

🖥 Work from home or from our offices in the center of Malaga

💰 55k - 75k will be determined based on experience and expertise

🏡 Flexible working hours and unlimited remote days

🍲 Catered, free lunches and unlimited ice cream when working from the office

🏋 More perks like biweekly events

🎂 Don’t work on your birthday—enjoy an extra day of paid time off

📅 Holidays: 23 work days + 24th & 31st December off

About our culture:

If you love reading ‘empowering’ phrases like “vibrant collective” and “innovative individuals,” then be prepared to be disappointed…

That’s because to get a typical result, you have to do only typical things. But that’s not really our style.

We’re a community of chill and fun-loving humans who believe that work doesn’t have to be boring. We make each day exciting by collaborating together and enjoying the occasional bout of silliness: like a pool competition, potluck, party, or game of padel.

We’re kind of the cool kids in the PIM playground (if we do say so ourselves), and we love to challenge the status quo to help anyone break free from f*#king boring spreadsheets

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Avature's highly configurable, high-performance platform has been redefining the large-enterprise SaaS market since 2005, resulting in an exciting work environment full of technical challenges and learning opportunities with a team that never stops growing.

Our Senior Software Engineers work in small development teams that act like mini software companies, balancing refactoring and new feature development, defining and presenting road maps quarterly, and fully participating in the fundamental aspects of the commercial software business, from maintainability and usability to competitive positioning. If you are passionate about working in high-powered teams building out the complex components and services of a powerful multi-application SaaS platform and want to use your analytical and technical skills to tackle complex engineering challenges, Avature could be the place for you.

Your challenges and objectives:
• Achieve expert-level knowledge of our platform by understanding the... complex interaction of a wide range of services and feature sets, from framework layer to end user experience.
• Incorporate into your work product several computer science disciplines, such as high availability and high performance system design, industry-leading security standards, and intuitive user interface design.
• Abstract customer feature requests in order to build a highly flexible platform which allows users to customize it through tailored configurations and UI options.
• Learn and collaborate with different teams while tackling complex technical challenges in a fun and encouraging working environment.

Your day-to-day activities:
• Work with the product team on functional specifications of features (specs): interpret, analyze, and provide feedback.
• Design and write the code for the feature.
• Perform technical analysis of existing code and refactors to improve code quality.
• Review code from your peers in different teams.
• Promote and apply best practices during the entire development process, from the very early stages of technical analysis and design of solutions to the monitoring in production of your team’s code.

About you:

Minimum Qualifications:
• Work experience in software development
• Analytical/troubleshooting skills
• Strong background in OOP, SOLID principles, DDD, and unit testing
• Fluency in one or more of the following: PHP, JavaScript, Java, C++, Python
• Working knowledge of Unix, preferably Linux

About us:

Avature is a market leading enterprise SaaS Solution provider for global talent acquisition and talent management. We have a strong commitment to high quality engineering and customer service and are recognized innovators in the very large company market. We currently work with over 650 companies worldwide, including 110 of the Fortune 500, all of the Big Four consulting firms, the largest banks and manufacturers in the world, and five governments.

We design, build, implement, and support our product ourselves. With 26 releases a year and a strong commitment to innovation and quality engineering, our private cloud platform has become the product choice for the very large global organization.

At Avature, we value opportunities to learn and grow within a dynamic, creative, and collaborative environment. We encourage autonomy and empower our people to approach challenges innovatively while bringing their unique perspective to the table. We offer a career development program that supports continuous learning and thoughtful leadership, and that meaningfully impacts each individual’s professional trajectory.

What we offer:
• A fast-paced, energetic, and engaging environment.
• Flexible hours.
• Work remotely or come by the office as much as you want.
• Competitive salary, with one review a year.
• Sanitas health coverage.
• Four days a year to attend events related to professional development.
• End of year week off (December 26 to 31).
• Internet service expenses.
• Birthdays off.

An organizational culture that empowers everyone to be themselves is key to thrive in business, but more importantly, it is a pathway for creating a more equitable society. Avature fosters a diverse and inclusive environment and celebrates that each unique person brings something different to our team. We are committed to considering all qualified applicants equally and to promoting equal opportunities within our organization

jobs_results.description:
At PayRetailers, we are committed to providing cutting-edge solutions that empower businesses to succeed in Latin America. Our collaborative and inclusive work environment encourages creativity and growth, where every employee's contribution is valued. Get ready to embark on an exciting journey with us, as we strive to make a meaningful impact on the world of payments.

Marking a significant step in PayRetailers' European expansion strategy, we are building from the ground up our first Hub in Sofia to strengthen our position as a global player in the payments space and create new products that will make an impact in the Fintech industry.

We are looking for a passionate professional with a curious and continuous improvement mindset to develop high quality software through efficient code using industry best practices, positioning PayRetailers at the forefront of innovation in the industry.

Job Duties And Responsibilities:
• Developing and maintaining software products with the .Net... Core stack.
• Creating microservices based solutions using latest technologies such as ASP.NET Core, PostgreSQL, Cosmos NoSQL DB, Azure Service Bus, Redis, Azure Functions, API Gateway.
• Wrinting and executing high quality tests.
• Continiously improving gaps in maintainability, performace and code quality.
• Participating in architectural discussions demostrating deep technical knowledge.
• Having sense of ownership and ability to push things towards completion.
• Mentoring less experienced team members.
• Being able to explain complext technical solutions in clear and understandable way.

• Experience in agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).

• Experience in cloud application development (Azure)

jobs_results.title: Senior/Principal Software Engineer (Space Systems)
jobs_results.description:
The Payload and Ground Systems organization within the Northrop Grumman Space Systems pushes the boundaries of innovation, redefines engineering capabilities, and drives advances in various sciences. Our team is chartered with providing the skills, innovative technologies to develop, design, produce and sustain optimized product lines across the sector while providing a decisive advantage to the warfighter. Come be a part of our mission.

We are seeking either a Principal Software Engineer or Senior Principal Software Engineer to join our qualified, diverse team supporting Ruby. You will join a group of Software engineers that is adapting and upgrading an existing Command and Control platform for a new ground program. This position is located in Redondo Beach, CA.

The team is seeking a talented engineer who resolves software problems and utilizes software development and software design methodologies appropriate to the development environment. The successful candidate shall have... experience with C++, Perl or Python, requirements analysis and synthesis from system level to individual software components, experience with the full software design life cycle.

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To
• D esigns, develops, documents, tests and debugs applications software and systems that contain logical and mathematical solutions
• Conducts multidisciplinary research and collaborates with equipment designers and/or hardware engineers in the planning, design, development, and utilization of electronic data processing systems for product and commercial software
• Determines computer user needs; analyzes system capabilities to resolve problems on program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques and controls; prepares operating instructions; designs and develops compilers and assemblers, utility programs, and operating systems
• Ensures software standards are met

This requisition may be filled at a higher grade based on qualifications listed below.

Basic Qualifications For Principal Software Engineer
• Bachelor's degree with 5 years of relevant experience; Master's degree with 3 years of relevant experience; PhD; an additional 4 years of experience may be considered in lieu of degree
• Active Secret Clearance, and the ability to obtain TS/SCI
• Experience with Agile software development using C++ in a Linux environment
• Experienced with software requirements analysis and synthesis
• Experience developing ground satellite orbit determination software
• Experience with Perl or Python
• Experience with Redhat Linux to enable development of software in the following languages: C++, Java, Perl, Python
• Experience with the full software design life cycle
• Experience with Cornerstone

Basic Qualifications for Senior Principal Software Engineer:
• Bachelor's degree with 9 years of relevant experience; Master's degree with 7 years of relevant experience; PhD with 4 years of relevant experience; an additional 4 years of experience may be considered in lieu of degree
• Active Secret Clearance, and the ability to obtain TS/SCI
• Experience with Agile software development using C++ in a Linux environment
• Experienced with software requirements analysis and synthesis
• Experience developing ground satellite orbit determination software
• Experience with Perl or Python
• Experience with Redhat Linux to enable development of software in the following languages: C++, Java, Perl, Python
• Experience with the full software design life cycle
• Experience with Cornerstone

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience with Commercial Cloud Services (C2S) or Amazon Web Services (AWS)
• Experienced with Atlassian tool suite (JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket, etc.)
• CI poly or FSP
• Active TS/SCI
